_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: the self-contradicting-pack pass (B-022/23/24/33/35/36/38/39/41/44, SG-04) — 2026-08-20, twenty-nine packs and twenty-nine kits, clean tree
_raised: 3398/1912/635 -> 3543/1924/635 on the self-contradicting-pack pass, 2026-08-20. validate.py +145, attributed by running each function in isolation against this tree and against 30bfbc3: +58 validate_elevation_tokens_named (every --shadow-*/--*-glow a pack declares, named in its prose — 58 tokens across 29 packs); +14 validate_motion_bands (a press against the doctrine's band, plus every duration literal in a Components or Micro-interactions section against the pack's own tokens and the UI ceiling); +6 validate_release_register (duplicate CHANGELOG version, the Run stamps table, the missing-tag audit against UNTAGGED_RELEASES, and the declared exception that stopped being one); +6 validate_emphasis_base_layer (a banned weight or slant, per pack that bans one); +59 validate_status_vocabulary (the cross-pack status map in SURFACE_COMPOSITION.md, one existence check and one set-equality check per pack, plus the table-found check — it was prose until this commit and wrong in three places); +2 validate_pack_enumerations, which is the same count as before over one more site — package.json, the description npmjs.com renders. validate_radius_single_valued adds 0 on a clean tree by design: it calls check() only on a component that has two radii, so its floor contribution is zero and its proof is its plant. validate_palette.py +12: +7 validate_line_surface_collision (a line and a surface resolving to one colour, plus every token named in an '@role drawn-on:' list having to exist), +2 validate_pack and +3 validate_stated_ratios from instrument-console gaining --danger and --info, which its prose had legislated since its first release. sloplint.py unchanged, as expected — no colour moved and no lint target was added. Then 3543 -> 3550 on the B-001/B-002 close: +7 from validate_contract_declaration requiring a `Contract: core` line to NAME what it declines (one check per core pack, seven of them). `awning` shipped a bare `Contract: core` and the guard caught it on its first run — a narrow pack and an unfinished pack read identically until the declination is written down. Then 3550 -> 3558 on B-006: +8 from validate_every_surface_class_is_discoverable (one check per enumerated surface class, plus the description-found check). `briefing-room` ships for investor decks and the word `deck` appeared nowhere in the description, so the only phrasing anybody would use for that surface reached nothing. Then validate_palette.py 1924 -> 1951 on the B-013 close: +27 from the five tables that now declare the base their own numbers resolve against — atrium 6, cyclorama 12, router 5, orchard 3, prism 1. Every one of the 27 was already written in the library and none was checked; declaring the base ran the arithmetic over them without changing a single ratio. The same commit pins the coverage itself under `validate_palette.py:ratios`, because a check-count floor cannot see a base being deleted: removing one header moved 27 claims out of the arithmetic while the count of other checks stayed put (watched, 348 -> 342). Then 3558 -> 3560 on the same commit: +2 from `_release_register()` refusing an `[Unreleased]` heading that is not the first section and refusing a second one. 1.45.0's release commit wrote its summary above the accumulated section and left it in place, so the shipped version's detail was labelled unreleased and this entry would have been written on top of published notes. The duplicate-version check could not see it because `Unreleased` is not a version. Then 1951 -> 2087 on the B-017 close: +136 from validate_declared_semantic_sets, which compares the peer groups a pack DECLARES — a state map in its token layer, a distinctness claim, or its own disclosure that two tokens share a hue family — and computes any distance such a disclosure states. `validate_theme`'s peer set is STATUS_TOKENS plus the accent, so `field-notes`, whose reason to exist is provenance, had all four of its provenance tokens excluded by name; two of them were 3.2 apart at full colour and 0.8 under deuteranopia and no check could see it. Then 2087 -> 2091 on the B-048 close: +4 from validate_composited_fill_contrast, which computes text on a fill a Components row asks you to COMPOSITE. `validate_stated_ratios` cannot see such a row because it states an instruction rather than a ratio: `scoreboard`'s secondary button shipped a 10-12px/600 label at 3.16:1 that way. Measured before it was written — 44 lines in the library put a token beside a percentage and only TWO state a composite fill AND a text size, one failing and one passing at 12.4:1, which is what makes it a check. Then 2092 -> 2119 on the B-050 close: +27 from validate_prescribed_pairs, the Components-table sweep that row asked for. A row prescribes a pair — '`--accent` fill, `--on-accent` label' — and its hover and active cells replace one half of it, so contrast(label, fill) is derivable at every state and nothing derived it. 13 rows across 7 packs name both halves; the two the widened phrasings added both carried a defect on the first run. Then 3560 -> 3619 on the board-integrity pass: +59 from validate_board_columns, one check per row in backlog.md and verification.md. Three rows here carried a shell pipe inside a code span, so their status cells read `sort -u`, `` `datasheet` run, stage 0 `` and `medium`, and the queue that orders this loop's work skipped BOTH `high` rows in the file — B-004 and B-014 — for ten iterations. The rows were never wrong; the table was. Then validate_palette.py 2214 -> 2218 and sloplint.py 635 -> 636 on the atrium widening: the pack gained four sections and the ratios they state are computed like any other. The contract split moved 7 core / 22 widened -> 6 core / 23. One live subject of each kind. Anchored on the heading, never the string — a `core` pack names `## Hero` inside its contract line to DECLINE it, and a substring search counted six such packs as having a hero.
_not_raised_by_the_widening: Measured old-pattern-against-new on one tree: the widened separator adds 51 spans across all 1025 text files but only 2 inside the source list validate_counted_claims reads, which is why the floor moves by 2 and not by 51. The rest are in CHANGELOG.md, docs/audit/, docs/evidence/ and test/*.py -- historical narration ('the ten-heading contract', 'a nine-heading pack') plus one branch name, 3 of which the identifier exemption drops. Adding any of those files to the source list means adjudicating each span, not adding a regex escape.

validate_palette.py:ratios._why: Measured on the B-013 close, 2026-08-20: 513 stated ratios — 348 computed, 15 naming a partner this pack cannot pair, 150 reaching no check (0 in a table declaring no base, 10 at a gradient stop, 140 prose). Before it the line said 336 guarded, of which 15 had never been through the arithmetic: the tally was incremented before the pairs were computed. The 27 table claims were closed by declaring the base each table's own numbers resolve against — atrium/router/orchard on `--bg`, cyclorama on `--ink` with four cells naming `--field-2` — every one confirmed by computing it, none of them invented. Unchanged by the B-017 close: the declared-set check adds no ratio claims, and the three pinned figures were re-measured at 348/15/150 after it landed. Raised to 349 on the B-048 close: `scoreboard`'s secondary button now STATES the ratio it renders (`--ink-soft` at 4.55:1 on `--surface-2`) instead of an alpha instruction nothing computed. Correcting the spec had first moved the pair out of every check — the same trap as B-017, where fixing a false distinctness claim removed the only thing making the pair observable, so the claim is stated in the form the gate reads. Raised to 353 on the B-050 close: `maquette` gained `--on-model` with its ratio stated, and `prism`'s `$` prompt now states 4.70:1 on `--surface-2` instead of using a token its own layer calls furniture. A fourth new claim had to be rewritten because 'on' and its token landed on either side of a line break — the same refusal B-039's fix met, and correctly. Then the B-003 pass, 2026-08-20: 353 -> 448 computed and 150 -> 57 unguarded. One hypothesis was tested against all 140 prose claims — 'this ratio is against the pack's own field' — and 88 of them agreed with it arithmetically, on 77 lines. Those lines now name `--bg` instead of saying 'on the field' or naming nothing, which is more precise prose, not less. Four of the 77 went red on the first run and each was a real find: editing a line where ONE claim resolved put its neighbours under the arithmetic too, and `blueprint`'s `3:1` was a floor whose word 'floor' had wrapped, `proscenium`'s subject was the words 'Body ink', `tenor`'s subject sat on the previous line. The 52 that did not agree were left alone. Raised to 452 on the atrium widening — and the first attempt wrote 453, an estimate rather than a count, which this ratchet refused in the same breath: five ratios stated in `## Components`, each naming its partner on one line. `--accent` at 4.17:1 on `--surface` is the one an implementer needed and no section had ever said: the accent is safe on `--bg` and on `--ink`, and not on the cream card.
